title: A/R Summary: ticking several customers quickly shows rows for all of them
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role, with {Location-A} as your current location.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Five customers, {Customer-A}, {Customer-B}, {Customer-C}, {Customer-D} and {Customer-E}, each have one open invoice on today's date, of different amounts, and nothing else open.
    For example: {Customer-A} to {Customer-E} are ZZAUTOTEST S5-38 Quick 1 to ZZAUTOTEST S5-38 Quick 5, with invoices of $100.00, $200.00, $300.00, $400.00 and $500.00.
  • Starting screen: A/R Summary (Reports, then "A/R Aging Summary" under ACCOUNTS RECEIVABLE in the left menu) is open in a desktop browser window 1440 px wide, as opened from the Reports menu.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Click the Customer chip.
  2. Tick {Customer-A}, {Customer-B}, {Customer-C}, {Customer-D} and {Customer-E} one after another, as fast as you can (within about two seconds).
  3. Close the menu.
  4. Wait until the report stops loading.
  5. Read the chip, the rows and the Totals row.
  6. Wait ten seconds without touching anything, then read the rows and the Totals row again.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the Customer menu opens.
  • Step 2: all five are ticked.
  • Step 3: the menu closes.
  • Step 4: the report loads once more and shows its rows.
  • Step 5: the chip reads "Customer: 5 customers"; exactly five rows, one per customer, and the Totals row's Total is the five amounts added up (with the example amounts 100.00 + 200.00 + 300.00 + 400.00 + 500.00 = $1,500.00).
  • Step 6: the same five rows and the same Totals: no late answer for an earlier tick replaces them.

Why: the report waits until you stop ticking and then asks once, dropping any answer still on its way for an earlier tick (tech plan). The wait itself is too short to see; the end state is what a tester checks.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 5 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11535 (Story 5, Filters: customer or vendor, past due and location)

  • S5-R13: “The customer chip (A/R) and vendor chip (A/P) and their open menus are the native ones: Customer exactly as Sales By Customer's Customer filter (person icon), Vendor exactly as Inventory Value's Vendor filter (truck icon, "Search vendors"). The menu has a search box, an "All customers" or "All vendors" row, the native line "All customers are included. Pick one or more to narrow." (or vendors) while none is ticked, and the list; several can be ticked. The chip reads "Customer: All customers" or "Vendor: All vendors" in the resting (grey) style when none is ticked, the name when one is (shortened with "..." when long), and "Customer: N customers" or "Vendor: N vendors" when N are. The ticked customers or vendors narrow every row, group, total, page, sort and export; the Location list does not change (S5-R3).”
  • S5-R18: “The Totals row always adds up exactly the rows the filters leave (customer or vendor, Past due, Location), on screen on every page, in the PDF and in the CSV. On A/R Collection and A/P Unpaid Invoices this fixes today's Totals row, which ignores the customer or vendor filter.”

From: Tech plan "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter — Technical Implementation Plan" (2026-10-21, uploaded 22 Oct 2026), read 22 Oct 2026

  • Tech plan §1 NFR-005: “FE sends one request per settled filter change: chip→query path debounced (~400 ms), superseded requests aborted, opening fetch gated until URL state is reconciled.”
  • Tech plan §6 Phase 1, unit tests: “FE: 5 rapid ticks → 1 fetch; superseded signal aborted;”

The design's own words:

  • "31-60 days and 91+ days ticked: the chip reads "Past due: 2 ranges" in blue. The Summary lists only customers with an amount in those ranges, at full balances; the Totals row adds up exactly these rows. S5-R15, S5-R16, S5-R17, S5-R18, S5-R19." (caption of "Past due ticked")
  • "Customer menu with 10 Trucking and 4 Star Truck Repair ticked ("2 selected", shown as tags in the search box): the chip reads "Customer: 2 customers", and rows and Totals narrow to them (4 Star Truck Repair has nothing open). S5-R13, S5-R14, S5-R19." (caption of "Two customers ticked")

Design note (DR-04): the design shows the Customer menu with two ticked shows the ticked names as tags in the search box, a clear "×", and "2 selected" on the "All customers" row. Closed without a question: No conflict: PRD S5-R13 "Customer exactly as Sales By Customer's Customer filter"; the PRD lists the menu's main rows, the design shows the native extras. The design case checks them.
